rows.Description: Faith itself — its presence, growth, and protection. Includes Tawheed, Yaqeen, and the rejection of Shirk.
The oneness of Allah and the certainty of faith. Anchors the entire belief system.
The five pillars and the voluntary acts — prayer, fasting, zakat, hajj, and the smaller sunan.
Remembrance of Allah and recitation / reflection on the Quran. The nourishment of the heart.
Akhlaq — patience, honesty, humility, generosity, gentleness, and their opposites.
How we treat family, neighbours, spouses, the poor, the wronged, the living, and the dead.
Attitude toward the material world — wealth, status, time, body, and possessions.
Patience in trials and reliance on Allah. The two pillars of the tested soul.
The classical *amradh al-qalb* — Riya, Kibr, Hasad, Nifaq, Ujb, Hiqd, and their remedies.
Mahabbah — love of Allah, longing for the Akhirah, fear, hope, and tawakkul.
